jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team at Patrick Space Force Base, Florida. This position offers an exciting opportunity to support the Space Training and Readiness Command (STARCOM) by providing data analysis, reporting, and visualizations to improve operational effectiveness, and support mission success.

The Data Analyst will collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple enterprise systems to develop workforce analysis, and support enterprise decisions making. The successful candidate will develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to government stakeholders. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Develop and continuously enhance STARCOM's workforce analytics capabilities, providing timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
Analyze workforce, operational, and organizational data to identify trends, measure performance, and support planning efforts
Develop, maintain, and enhance executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using data from multiple enterprise systems
Design and implement automated reporting solutions, databases, and analytics tools to improve efficiency and data accessibility
Identify workforce trends, hiring metrics, readiness indicators, and organizational performance measures to inform leadership decisions
Collaborate with government stakeholders to gather requirements and develop reporting and analytical solutions
Respond to leadership and stakeholder requests by preparing timely, accurate reports, dashboards, and analytical products
Validate, integrate, cleanse, and standardize data from multiple sources to ensure data quality and consistency
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and recommend enhancements that increase efficiency
Prepare reports, presentations, and data visualizations that communicate analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Develop predictive models and trend analyses to support workforce planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
5+ years of experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) organizations in data analytics, business intelligence, workforce analytics, or a related field
Demonstrated experience collecting, integrating, cleansing, validating, and analyzing large datasets from multiple enterprise systems
Experience developing executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Excel, or similar business intelligence tools
Experience analyzing business processes, workforce data, and operational metrics to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Experience collaborating with stakeholders to gather business requirements and develop data-driven analytical solutions
Experience implementing predictive analytics, forecasting models, and trend analysis to support strategic planning and organizational decision-making
Strong understanding of data quality management, governance, and data validation best practices
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor of Art (BA) or Bachelor of Science (BS)
Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of education

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO
Paid Paternal leave
Tuition reimbursement
Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Company Summary

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

Company Employment Statement

The above job description does not all encompassing as positions, functions, and qualifications may vary depending on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Vanguard is a global leader in investment management and financial services, committed to helping clients achieve their long-term financial goals. With a mission to serve the long-term financial wellbeing of its clients, Vanguard emphasizes innovation, integrity, and a client-centric approach. The company fosters a culture of continuous learning and development, encouraging employees to grow both professionally and personally. From its headquarters in Malvern to its offices worldwide, Vanguard strives to deliver transformative products and services that positively impact clients' lives. The organization values collaboration, transparency, and a strong sense of purpose, making it an ideal environment for talented professionals seeking meaningful work in the financial sector.

About The Role

The Security Engineering Governance & Data Analyst at Vanguard is a pivotal role responsible for delivering comprehensive, data-driven insights into technology performance, operational health, and financial management within the Security Engineering domain. This position involves developing executive reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable leadership to monitor progress, identify risks, and optimize technology investments effectively. The analyst will work closely with cross-functional teams—including technology, finance, and business units—to translate complex operational and financial data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and governance. The role emphasizes measuring performance, enhancing transparency, and fostering effective governance of security initiatives and technology modernization efforts. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of cybersecurity and financial management, and the ability to communicate complex data clearly to executive stakeholders.

Qualifications

Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 2 years in cybersecurity and project management preferred.
Experience within the financial services industry and a solid technical background are highly desirable.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required; a graduate degree is preferred.

Responsibilities

Analyze and report on technology spending, consumption trends, and cost drivers to enhance transparency and support effective financial management.
Identify opportunities for cost efficiency and optimize technology investments aligned with organizational goals.
Develop, maintain, and improve executive reports, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into operational, financial, and technological outcomes.
Synthesize complex data sets into meaningful insights to support leadership in strategic decision-making.
Monitor and report on the progress of technology initiatives, including key milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
Support governance processes through detailed reporting and analysis, enabling visibility into project progress and organizational priorities.
Track and analyze portfolio performance metrics, operational health indicators, and emerging technology trends to identify risks and opportunities.
Provide insights and recommendations to help leadership manage priorities and achieve desired results.
Build strong relationships with technology, finance, and business stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment across departments.
Support planning, reporting, and governance activities by offering subject matter expertise, analytical support, and actionable insights.

Benefits

Vanguard offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional development of its employees. These include competitive compensation, health and wellness programs, retirement savings plans, and paid time off. The organization promotes a healthy work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and encourages continuous learning with training and development opportunities. Employees also benefit from a collaborative and inclusive culture that values diversity and innovation, providing a stimulating environment to grow and succeed. Vanguard’s commitment to employee development and engagement ensures that team members are supported in their career aspirations and personal goals.

Equal Opportunity

Vanguard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to serve our clients and innovate effectively. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. Vanguard encourages applicants from all backgrounds to join our team and contribute to our mission of helping clients achieve their financial goals.

jobs.description:
Our client, a growing and highly respected excavation, demolition, and site development contractor, is seeking an Administration Assistant / Project Coordinator to support multiple active construction projects across the region.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys coordinating with municipalities, utility providers, project teams, trucking vendors, and regulatory agencies to keep projects moving forward. The successful candidate will play a critical role in permitting, compliance, project documentation, logistics coordination, and operational support.

What You'll Be Doing

Manage and secure permits for excavation, demolition, hauling, utility work, street openings, and related construction activities
Coordinate with city, county, state, and local agencies to ensure project compliance and permit approvals
Maintain contractor licenses, registrations, certifications, and renewal schedules
Schedule and coordinate inspections with municipalities, utility providers, and regulatory agencies
Support project managers with permitting timelines, mobilization planning, and project startup activities
Track hauling permits, trucking compliance documentation, route approvals, disposal records, and load tracking
Maintain project records, permit logs, safety documentation, daily reports, and project closeout files
Assist with scheduling subcontractors, trucking vendors, inspections, deliveries, and agency approvals

What We're Looking For

Experience administrative experience with permit coordination, project administration, project coordination, construction operations, or a similar role
Strong understanding of construction permitting processes and municipal approvals
Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and jurisdictions simultaneously
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction management systems

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Join a growing company with a strong reputation in the construction industry
Diverse and highly visible role supporting a variety of projects
Opportunity to work closely with leadership, project managers, and field operations
Competitive compensation, benefits, and long-term growth potential

If you have experience navigating construction permits, coordinating project documentation, and keeping complex projects on track, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for a confidential discussion.

new_jobs.title: Administrative Assistant Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Our client, a growing and highly respected excavation, demolition, and site development contractor, is seeking an Administration Assistant / Project Coordinator to support multiple active construction projects across the region.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys coordinating with municipalities, utility providers, project teams, trucking vendors, and regulatory agencies to keep projects moving forward. The successful candidate will play a critical role in permitting, compliance, project documentation, logistics coordination, and operational support.

What You'll Be Doing

Manage and secure permits for excavation, demolition, hauling, utility work, street openings, and related construction activities
Coordinate with city, county, state, and local agencies to ensure project compliance and permit approvals
Maintain contractor licenses, registrations, certifications, and renewal schedules
Schedule and coordinate inspections with municipalities, utility providers, and regulatory agencies
Support project managers with permitting timelines, mobilization planning, and project startup activities
Track hauling permits, trucking compliance documentation, route approvals, disposal records, and load tracking
Maintain project records, permit logs, safety documentation, daily reports, and project closeout files
Assist with scheduling subcontractors, trucking vendors, inspections, deliveries, and agency approvals

What We're Looking For

Experience administrative experience with permit coordination, project administration, project coordination, construction operations, or a similar role
Strong understanding of construction permitting processes and municipal approvals
Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and jurisdictions simultaneously
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction management systems

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Join a growing company with a strong reputation in the construction industry
Diverse and highly visible role supporting a variety of projects
Opportunity to work closely with leadership, project managers, and field operations
Competitive compensation, benefits, and long-term growth potential

If you have experience navigating construction permits, coordinating project documentation, and keeping complex projects on track, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for a confidential discussion.
